says: Check a record, sign it, and add it to a store. loops emit also fills in what a writer's tool may: the thing, the keys it sets, every live record of the thing, and the heads' about and occurred.
Fix a vertex's result at a boundary, as a value anyone can work out again.
Say no, with a code from a closed set and the path to what broke the rule. Never guess.
Bring each record's forms together, one per id. Keep a payload any place holds, unless a held record erases it.
Refuse records that aren't entitled to their prev. Standing joins this check in step 3.
A source takes the records its store, kinds, mention and thing choose.
A where test answers yes, no, or unknown when the reader lacks the payload. present means the field was written. On a list, is asks whether a member equals the value, and no bound holds.
Walk prev inside a thing to its heads, the records nothing replaces. Following keys, read a thing by its live setters: for each key, the setters nothing above replaces.

Split what a slot selects by a key read from each record: its kind, its observer, what it mentions under a prefix, or a payload field. A payload list puts the record in one group per member. Always after settling, admission and the heads.
Turn what was taken into a slot's value.
Write state as keyed sections, each with a nonempty, distinct id. Views shaped for an audience are planned.

Turn the edits a parse found into records, emitted together.
